sentences.en: Beautiful day, isn't it?
How was your weekend?
Did you see the game last night?
By the way, have you heard the news?
sentences.zh: 對了，你聽說那個消息了嗎？

sentences.en: Can you believe how hot it is today?
sentences.zh: 你能相信今天有多熱嗎？

sentences.en: Have you tried that new restaurant nearby?
sentences.zh: 你有試過附近那間新餐廳嗎？

sentences.en: I love your outfit today.
sentences.zh: 我好喜歡你今天的穿搭。

sentences.en: Any plans for the holidays?
The traffic was terrible this morning.
I can't believe it's already Friday.
Have you been watching anything good lately?
sentences.zh: 你最近有在看什麼好看的嗎？

sentences.en: I heard it's going to rain tomorrow.
How's everything going?
I just got back from vacation.
Time really flies, doesn't it?
Did you do anything fun this weekend?
sentences.zh: 你這週末做了什麼好玩的嗎？

sentences.en: I'm so ready for the weekend.
Have you read any good books lately?
sentences.zh: 你最近有看什麼好書嗎？

sentences.en: It looks like spring is finally here.
How's your family doing?
I need my coffee to get through the morning.
sentences.zh: 我需要咖啡才能撐過早上。

sentences.en: This weather is perfect for a walk.
sentences.zh: 這種天氣最適合散步了。

sentences.en: What did you get up to last night?
I'm thinking of ordering takeout tonight.
Have you heard that new song by...?
sentences.zh: 你有聽過那首⋯⋯的新歌嗎？

sentences.en: Mondays are always tough.
I saw the funniest video online today.
sentences.zh: 我今天在網路上看到一個超搞笑的影片。

sentences.en: Are you a morning person or a night owl?
sentences.zh: 你是早起型還是夜貓子？

sentences.en: It smells amazing in here.
I could really use a vacation right now.
sentences.zh: 我現在真的很需要放個假。
